verdict.rationale: Square's Developer docs confirm a dedicated Disputes API with 'Process Disputes' and sandbox testing pages, indicating retrieval and response submission can occur programmatically, but the evidence only shows page titles with no detail on evidence assembly formats, submission payloads, or end-to-end automation examples. Marketing copy (square-docs-30) also frames disputes as something Square manages for the seller, which is not detailed API guidance for agent-driven evidence submission. Missing for 10: concrete API reference/examples for retrieving a dispute, evidence-upload endpoints, and submitting a full response, plus any independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent completing this flow.
